from.place: The proof clause invoking Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 20.26.9 (Stacks Tag 06YD): a bounded above complex of flat modules over a ringed space is K-flat.

title: Bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space. Every bounded-above complex of flat \mathcal O_X-module sheaves is K-flat in the sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex].

proof.text: Fix x in X. Since each term of the bounded-above complex is a flat \mathcal O_X-module sheaf, its stalk at x is a flat \mathcal O_{X,x}-module by [lem-pc-flat-sheaf-stalk-flat]. The stalk complex is therefore bounded above and termwise flat.

source.place: Tag 06YD, proof of Lemma 20.26.9, using Modules Tag 05NE

proof.text: Apply the bounded-above flat module lemma [lem-pc-module-bounded-flat-kflat] to the stalk complex over the ring \mathcal O_{X,x}. It follows that the stalk complex is K-flat: tensoring it with every acyclic complex of \mathcal O_{X,x}-modules gives an acyclic total complex.

source.place: Tag 06YD, proof of Lemma 20.26.9, using More on Algebra Tag 064K

proof.text: Because every stalk complex is K-flat, the reverse implication of the stalk criterion [lem-pc-kflat-stalk-criterion] gives that the original bounded-above flat sheaf complex is K-flat.
